known_gaps: actions/__init__.py (ALL_ACTIONS_IN_ORDER) and each actions/*.py were not readable (GitHub robots block on tree/raw). The exact verb list and implied_actions/isolated/last_in_chain flags are reconstructed from README + 3dm.py + CLAUDE.md. Step 0 of the remediation plan regenerates this file from `3dm help` and the source to close the gap.
Version of 3dmake covered: current main (README mentions scale options, preview planes, min_3dmake_version, which post-date v0.8).

rules: Multiple actions can be chained; they execute in the fixed internal order ALL_ACTIONS_IN_ORDER, NOT the order typed (verified: 3dm.py iterates ALL_ACTIONS_IN_ORDER and runs those present in the verb set).
Dashed options may be interleaved with actions (parse_known_args) (verified). Unknown dashed options are a hard error 'Unknown option(s): ...' (verified).
Any trailing token containing a '.' is treated as an input file; more than one input file is an error 'Multiple inputs not supported yet' (verified).
Any non-dashed token without a '.' is treated as an action verb; an unknown one errors "Unknown action 'x'" (verified). Consequence: `3dm new myproject` is invalid.
If the first input file is .scad, 'build' is added to the verb set automatically (verified).
Implied actions are added recursively, e.g. print implies slice (verified in README: 'print implies that 3DMake must slice').

Actions flagged isolated cannot be combined with other actions: error "The action 'x' can only be used on its own" (verified mechanism; which verbs are isolated: setup, help, version at minimum per CLAUDE.md; self-update is checked by name in the update notice).
Actions flagged last_in_chain cannot be followed by later actions in internal order (verified mechanism; likely print) .

Single-file mode (input file given): build dir is a temp dir; model name derives from file stem; outputs are copied to the current directory and 'Result is in <file>' printed (verified). --model cannot be combined with an input file.

Accepted input types are per action (input_file_types): .stl, .scad, .gcode (verified mechanism; exact per-action mapping: verify). Action with no input types errors 'This action does not take an input file'.
Project discovery: ./3dmake.toml, else ../3dmake.toml ('Using 3DMake project in parent directory...') (verified). Project settings override global defaults.toml, CLI flags override both (verified).
If the config dir does not exist and the verb is not 'setup', 3dm interactively offers to run setup (verified).
Errors print 'ERORR: <message>' (sic) without stack trace unless --debug (verified). Exit codes: 1 on error, 2 on Ctrl+C (verified).
After running, a background update check may print '3DMake X is available (you have Y). Run '3dm self-update' to install it.' (verified).
invocation_grammar.pipeline_order_note: Position of info, image, edit-*, list-*, test-connect, install-libraries relative to the pipeline is verify. CLAUDE.md lists pipeline: Build -> Measure -> Orient -> Preview -> Slice -> Print.

actions.name: setup
actions.summary: Interactive first-time/upgrade configuration: creates config dir, copies default profiles/overlays, asks for default printer profile, OctoPrint host/key, Gemini key, Ollama model. On upgrade preserves settings and optionally modified profiles/overlays.

actions.name: new
actions.summary: Create a new 3DMake project in the CURRENT directory (src/, build/, 3dmake.toml with strict_warnings=true; default main.scad template with $fs/$fa and a sphere). Takes no name argument.

actions.name: edit-model
actions.summary: Open src/<model>.scad in the configured editor.

actions.name: edit-overlay
actions.summary: Open an overlay .ini in the editor; creates it if missing (asks whether it is printer-specific, stored under overlays/<profile>/).

actions.name: edit-profile
actions.summary: Open an existing printer profile .ini in the editor (cannot create new printer profiles).

actions.name: edit-global-config
actions.summary: Open defaults.toml in the editor.

actions.name: edit-prompt
actions.summary: Open the LLM prompt file used by info; first run seeds the default prompt. Supports $object_count placeholder.

actions.name: build
actions.summary: OpenSCAD .scad -> STL in build/ (live elapsed-time output). Applies libraries/local_libraries, strict_warnings, scale options. Collects preview plane names.

actions.name: orient
actions.summary: Auto-orient (Tweaker3) for printing; produces <model>-oriented.stl. Implies build for .scad sources.

actions.name: preview
actions.summary: Flat tactile silhouette preview as SVG plus thin extruded STL; or a cross-section at a named preview plane. Output SVG styling via svg_stroke_width / svg_fill_color.
notes: Silhouette views: 3sil, frontsil, backsil, leftsil, rightsil, topsil
Plane views: name defined in SCAD via xy_preview_plane/xz_preview_plane from 3dmake/preview.scad; selected with -v level#1; forces fresh build; uses un-oriented model

actions.name: slice
actions.summary: PrusaSlicer to GCODE using profile + overlays; prints filament length, weight and per-extrusion-type breakdown; errors if object exceeds build plate in X/Y/Z; honors copies and scale.

actions.name: print
actions.summary: Send GCODE to printer. Implies slice. print_mode: octoprint | bambu_connect | bambu_lan. auto_start_prints controls whether the print starts immediately.

actions.name: test-connect
actions.summary: Test connection to OctoPrint or Bambu printer without printing.

actions.name: info
actions.summary: Describe a model: bounding-box dimensions always; with Gemini/OpenRouter/Ollama/OpenAI-compatible configured, renders multiple angles and returns an AI description. -i enables interactive follow-up questions.

actions.name: image
actions.summary: Render PNG images of the model from named angles on an x-y grid, auto-centered/zoomed.

actions.name: list-profiles
actions.summary: List available printer profiles.

actions.name: list-overlays
actions.summary: List available overlays.

actions.name: list-libraries
actions.summary: List library-manager libraries with documentation URLs.

actions.name: install-libraries
actions.summary: Download libraries named in the project's libraries list that are not present. Local libraries need no install.

actions.name: self-update
actions.summary: Upgrade 3DMake to the latest release.

actions.name: version
actions.summary: Print version and the 3DMake config folder location.

actions.name: help
actions.summary: List all actions (docstrings come from handler functions).
